Section 6.6 of ANSI/ASSP A10.11 shall be amended by adding a new sentence at the end of the section, as follows, "However, in no case shall the largest opening area for debris netting when used horizontally be larger than one-half square inch (323 mm 2 ), with no opening larger than 1/2 inch (13 mm 2 )* in the vertical or horizontal dimensions and 3/4 inch (19 mm) in any other dimension."
Editor's note: As set forth in L.L. 2021/126; correct measurement is 1/2 inch (13 mm).
